headline: US Stock Market Today S&P 500 Futures Edge Higher On Mixed Growth Signals
summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Friday, Aug, 7 2026 US stock futures are slightly higher this morning, with E mini S&P 500 contracts up about 0.2%, as investors weigh strong services activity against softer hiring and shifting interest rate expectations. The composite PMI for July sits at 54.5, which is a broad scorecard showing private sector growth at a nine month high. headline: US economy shed 23,000 jobs in July, economists forecasted gain of 80K
summary: The US economy shrank by 23,000 non-farm payroll jobs in July, according to the latest report from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). This was far below economists' forecasts of a gain of 80,000, while the employment rate fell to 4.1%.

headline: July jobs report: Manufacturing sector is 'treading water' but still strong
summary: The US economy shed 23,000 non-farm payroll jobs in July, according to the latest report from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), which was far below economists' estimates of 80,000. UBS Global Wealth Management head of taxable fixed income strategy Leslie Falconio and Annex Wealth Management chief economist and strategist Brian Jacobsen react to the jobs data and assess how the Federal Reserve may act on interest rates based on this data.
